newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains recover in PM from barley-led slide.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains recover in PM from barley-led slide.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended little changed on Friday.
Weaker sterling bolstered afternoon trade and helped prices recover from a slide induced by merchant selling of barley earlier on, traders said.
In wheat, active November last traded unchanged at 84.00 stg, on volume of 145 of a total 462 lots.
November barley, with 78 of a total 90 lots, also last traded unchanged at 80.00 stg.
Barley had led a slide in early trade on merchant hedge selling in response to farmer selling, as the first supplies have come off the fields in recent days.
"This always happens when it rains," one trader noted. The weather meant farmers could not work in the fields, so they came in and sold grain, he reckoned.
Wheat came down with it, with November hitting a low of 83.50 stg.
But easier sterling in the afternoon, and the anticipation of further currency easing in the short term, brought out shipper selling to create a late recovery.
